_comment: Tier-2: verifies febio::heat#0 — an unregistered <Module type=...> value is not diagnosed, it SEGFAULTS. FEBioModuleSection.cpp hands the string to FEModelBuilder::SetActiveModule() with no existence check. Runs four bad module strings ('heat' and 'biphasic-FSI', both of which OASiS templates used and neither of which exists in FEBio 4.12, plus the pure case errors 'Solid' and 'SOLID') and one positive control ('solid'). Verified 2026-08-03 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d: all four exit with SIGSEGV, no ERROR box, no FAILED! line, no .log file; the positive control reads SUCCESS. The positive control is what makes the four crashes attributable to the module string. NO-BINARY BEHAVIOUR (changed 2026-08-03): a missing febio4 is now a FAILURE, not a skip. The fixture prints 'FAIL:' and returns 1, expect_in_output pins the success TOKEN rather than the bare key prefix, and 'skipped_no_binary' is in forbid_in_output. Previously all five febio fixtures printed '<key>=skipped_no_binary', returned 0 and satisfied a bare '<key>=' prefix expectation, so on a host without FEBio the rows were green while verifying nothing and the tier-2 floor certified an unrun check. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 replaces the four unregistered module strings with the REGISTERED name "solid". Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'unknown_module_segfault_count=4' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
